name: Fire 100
description: 🔥💯 punctuates wins and milestones. The combo reads as the louder alternative to a single 🎉. The read depends on context, but the register itself does not.
meaning: Used to mark a moment the sender wants punctuated with confetti. 🔥💯 shows up on big news — engagements, grad photos, new jobs, new houses. The read depends on context, but the register itself does not.

faqs.question: Is 🔥💯 Gen Z slang?
faqs.answer: 🔥💯 is multigenerational. The celebration register is universal — the cue does not depend on age-coded slang to land.

faqs.question: What does 🔥💯 mean on a birthday?
faqs.answer: On a birthday 🔥💯 is the default celebration-coded reaction. The combo lands under any happy-anniversary thread.

faqs.question: What does 🔥💯 mean from a stranger?
faqs.answer: From a stranger 🔥💯 reads as genuine celebration of a public post. The combo is the same on comment sections regardless of relationship.

faqs.question: Can 🔥💯 be sarcastic?
faqs.answer: 🔥💯 is rarely sarcastic. The celebration-coded register is too upbeat to mask real sarcasm; if the irony is the point, the lead-up will tell you.
